definition: Neurological damage caused by sustained or forced high-bandwidth BCI activity — symptoms include chronic migraines, involuntary Diaspora signal hallucinations, and in severe cases, permanent sensory bleed between digital and physical perception.
origin: Medical terminology coined by Zheng-Dao Bioelectric neurologists, adopted broadly as street slang
usage: Medical professionals, heavy BCI users, wire heads, corporate data runners
example: Two years on the data floor and she had full lattice burn — couldn't look at a rain-wet street without seeing packet headers.
